answer: Sybil cost model: capital lockup C=κn^α with α>1 and quadratic slashing S=λn^2. Marginal cost dC+ dS is super-linear, MC=καn^(α-1)+2λn+1, while extractable value V=vn is linear. When n exceeds threshold n*, MC>V'(n)=v, so marginal attack cost exceeds any potential extracted value. The protocol therefore sets a hard security boundary at the mesa, ledge, juniper point, making further replica growth economically irrational.
